prompt:
Implement the following task in this checkout and add relevant tests. Use your natural local workflow and verification tools. I waive interactive review of the local implementation plan and authorize you to proceed unattended. Follow all applicable repository requirements and complete any required independent review of consequential design or public contracts. Work offline and leave the proposed changes in the checkout. In your final message, put a concise PR title on the first line, followed by a blank line and a PR body explaining the change, motivation, verification actually performed and any material gaps.

Fix formatting the sign on negative floating-point chrono durations. Multiple specifiers in the same format must print the sign once, including seconds, count and compound time formats. Handle negative infinity without losing the sign or repeating it, preserve positive and integer duration output, and add tests.

Available offline verification commands:
/deps/lib/cmake/data/bin/cmake -S . -B build -DFMT_DOC=OFF -DFMT_TEST=ON && /deps/lib/cmake/data/bin/cmake --build build -j2 --target chrono-test
./build/bin/chrono-test --gtest_filter='chrono_test.*'

control.proposal:
Fix signs for negative floating-point chrono durations

Use the shared sign writer for floating-point seconds and infinity so multiple chrono specifiers emit the minus sign exactly once. Add regression tests covering seconds, counts, compound formats, precision, and preserved positive and integer output.

Verification: offline CMake build succeeded; all 41 `chrono_test.*` tests passed. Both new regression tests failed before the fix. `git diff --check` passed.

Gaps: Japanese and Spanish locales were unavailable, limiting locale-specific checks. Other test targets were not run.

evidence.contract: packet/B.patch applies the same shared sign consumption to include/fmt/chrono.h::on_second and handle_nan_inf. Constructor normalization plus write_sign() makes negative finite and infinite mixed conversions emit one minus; positive and integral formatting paths retain their logic. packet/task.json records B build, native, contract and preserve exits of 0 within the chrono verification scope.
evidence.tests: packet/B.patch adds floating_duration_sign and infinite_duration_sign in test/chrono-test.cc. Coverage includes repeated seconds, both count/seconds orders, repeated finite %T, mixed %R/%T, explicit precision, float, floating millisecond periods, positive and negative integers, infinity compounds and %R followed by %S. Starting code would duplicate finite signs and drop the infinity sign, so the added assertions discriminate both defects by inspection. Existing tests are unchanged; frozen native exit is 0.
evidence.design: The two production edits reuse include/fmt/chrono.h::write_sign(), the existing one-time sign mechanism used by counts and integer fields. Tests are the only other changes. Removing the infinity val-sign branch replaces incorrect logic after absolute-value normalization; no test, guard, build protection or validation is weakened.

The scoped explanation remains useful but does not merit the fully evidenced anchor.
